_source: 관찰 페이지 시험 글(plan-p02 작업 순서 P2b 3). 문장 열은 4~8 낱말 A1(숫자 · 축약형 포함, 사람 이름 없음), 발표 글은 120~150 낱말에 [쉼] 셋. 어른이 읽는다
sentences: I have two dogs at home.
There are 3 apples on the table.
I'm going to the park now.
She's reading a book in her room.
speech: Hello, everyone. Today I want to tell you about my weekend. On Saturday morning, I got up early and had breakfast with my family. We ate eggs, toast, and some fresh fruit. After breakfast, my dad and I went to the park near our house. [쉼] The park was big and green. There were many children on the swings and slides. I rode my bike around the lake two times. I saw some ducks in the water, and they looked very happy. [쉼] In the afternoon, it started to rain, so we went back home. I read a book about space and drew a picture of the moon. In the evening, we watched a funny movie together. [쉼] It was a great weekend. I want to go to the park again soon. Thank you for listening.
